name: How long does it take to replace a kitchen faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a kitchen faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a standard kitchen faucet replacement can be completed within 1 to 3 hours. This timeframe can vary based on factors such as the accessibility of the existing plumbing, whether any old parts are corroded or difficult to remove, and the complexity of the new faucet's design. If additional plumbing modifications are required or unexpected issues arise, the process may take longer. Our technicians work efficiently to minimize disruption to your home while ensuring a proper and secure installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard kitchen faucet replacement usually takes 1 to 3 hours, depending on accessibility and the complexity of the installation.
